result.summary: The page is generally functional and well-structured, but one notable text truncation issue was found that affects content readability.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' appears to be rendered as 'Tokumaru Ramer' — the final letter 'n' appears cut off or incorrectly rendered, likely due to a font rendering or text clipping issue at the right edge of the text container where the rating badge overlaps.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant name text container has sufficient width and does not overlap with the rating/review badge. Apply proper text truncation (ellipsis) or adjust layout to prevent clipping of the last character.
